Equipment tender for the National Datacenter; no renting to others stated.
Tender for equipment only; no policy, rule or hosting of state data stated as in place.

facts.fact: ANSI, under the World Bank-financed Smart Villages project (PVI), invited quotations on 12 March 2026 for equipment to be installed at the National Datacenter to host the E-Cadastre platform.

NER.note: National Datacenter is only named as the future host of the e-cadastre; no hire, ownership or hosting in service stated.
